correctness.rationale: Each Gram off-diagonal is a two- or four-coordinate signed product because two unordered quadratic Walsh indices meet in zero or one coordinate. Exact Newton-identity moments reduce Parseval tightness to E(U)=n and Var(U)=2n(n-1). Positivity excludes one shell. Carathéodory on the exact uniform-cube moment barycenter provides at most three shell levels. The two-mass variance equation yields a necessary-and-sufficient Diophantine test with strictly positive unique masses. Mod-eight impossibilities follow from residues of squares modulo 8 or 16; parametrized infinite examples satisfy the equality identically. The package checker independently verifies exact Gram matrices and moment identities for finite examples. Numerical tests have no logical role in the universal proof.

originality.rationale: The original part is an exact minimal-layer two-versus-three theorem for Parseval sampling of all pure quadratic Walsh characters, including the necessary-and-sufficient integer two-layer equation, three mod-eight forbidden classes and two infinite families. Previously available full degree-at-most-two two-shell spectra, single-shell quadratic spectra, slice transforms and relative-design existence theory do not explicitly provide these resource-minimizing arithmetic conclusions; the general shell-moment formula, Newton identities and planar convexity are not new. Priority remains provisional because some aspects may be implicitly derivable from broader Gram or cubature theory.
residual_risks: An uninspected prior calculation could extract the same Diophantine frame criterion as an implicit corollary of more general Walsh Gram diagonalizations or positive radial cubature results.
Related public research summaries were available but their complete mathematical documents could not all be inspected; source comparisons for those summaries are expressly limited to stated claims.
Terminology conflicts are possible because Fisher-cardinality tight relative designs and Parseval tight frames are different notions.

value.rationale: The mathematical quantity is the minimum number of *full radial layers*, not an arbitrary small sample or invariant engineered for a computation. Exact Parseval sampling of all homogeneous quadratic Walsh coefficients is a natural frame-design objective. The theorem gives a complete exact decidability law for that minimum, proves the optimum is always either two or three, identifies three full infinite congruence classes where three are forced, and constructs two disparate infinite families with two. It exposes a genuine arithmetic obstruction to an otherwise convex moment-matching design, with explicit positive reconstruction weights.
